# Support

To report a potential vulnerability, follow the steps in **[Security](https://github.com/Lissy93/github-dashboards/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-security-issue)**.

For setup and usage, see the **[README](https://github.com/Lissy93/github-dashboards#readme)**.

To raise a bug, for something that's not working, **[Open a new Issue](https://github.com/Lissy93/github-dashboards/issues/new/choose)**.

If you'd like to help out with development, see **[Contributing](https://github.com/Lissy93/github-dashboards/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)**.
